history.summary: A UOL/SingLand-built 1,044 sqft 3BR in Upper Thomson, 420m from Upper Thomson TEL station, asking $2,203 PSF — bang in line with the $2,206 URA median. Reputable developer, strong location and 5.5% resale CAGR make it a sound hold, but it is fully priced at median, slightly off the frontier, and carries scattered early-cracking complaints, so the value is fair rather than a bargain.
history.rating_rationale: Solid investment-grade asset: UOL + SingLand pedigree, 420m to Upper Thomson TEL station, walkable Thomson Plaza and Ai Tong School, 435 units giving reasonable liquidity, and a verified 5.5% URA resale-only CAGR over 138 transactions. $2,300 quantum is in the deep band. Held to a plain Buy (not Strong) because it is priced exactly at the $2,206 median (no margin of safety), score 697 / MMR 1533 sits just below the frontier, the cited ~3.1% rental yield is unexciting, and there are user reports of cracks appearing within ~2 years. Good asset, fair price — not a discount.

history.summary: Quality UOL/SingLand 1BR priced clearly below the project's recent transaction average, sitting on top of two concrete catalysts — the $810M Thomson Reserve redevelopment next door and the coming Bright Hill TEL x CRL interchange.
history.rating_rationale: Asking $1,790 psf is well under Thomson Three's last-12-month transaction average of ~$2,094 psf (range $1,773-2,356), consistent with the -14.5% age-adj premium; even allowing that 1BR carries a structurally higher PSF, the entry is below project comps. The catalyst is decisive and dated, which earns medium (not low) confidence despite a thin 5-txn 1BR cohort: Bright Hill becomes a TEL x Cross Island Line interchange in 2030, and the adjacent former Thomson View site sold en bloc for $810M (sale order Jul 2025) to become the 1,240-unit Thomson Reserve, whose higher launch PSF re-rates the micro-market. Score 1000=790.
red_flags: Thin 1BR same-size cohort (5 txns) — single-comp PSF read should be treated cautiously
Small 500 sqft 1BR is the most cyclical, owner-occupier-thin segment; resale liquidity narrower than larger units
1,240-unit Thomson Reserve will add direct competing supply at TOP (~2030) for both resale and rental
catalysts: Bright Hill MRT becomes TEL x Cross Island Line interchange in 2030
$810M Thomson View en bloc -> Thomson Reserve (1,240 units) re-prices the Bright Hill corridor upward
Entry below verified recent project transaction average provides margin of safety
